template.event: local value = element:GetVar("ValueX"):GetFloat() value = ( value - 0.5 ) * $sliderWidth * 2 element:GetElement("Grabber")("xOffset"):SetFloat( value ) element:DoStoredScript( "onValueChanged" )

touchComponent.name: Touch

event.name: onTouchDrag
event.params: component, element, x, y, relX, relY

touchComponent.event:
local deltaX = x - element:GetVar("TouchDownX"):GetFloat() element:GetVar("TouchDownX"):SetFloat(x)
local newX = element("xOffset"):GetFloat() + deltaX if newX < -$sliderWidth then newX = -$sliderWidth end if newX > $sliderWidth then newX = $sliderWidth end
element("xOffset"):SetFloat( newX ) element:parent()("ValueX"):SetFloat( ( newX + $sliderWidth ) / ( $sliderWidth * 2 ) )
element:parent():DoStoredScript( "onValueChanged" )
